[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
Plays a short and familiar jingle whenever you go to bed and the end-of-day shipping menu appears.
This is reminiscent of games like [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2243710/Rune_Factory_3_Special/][b]Rune Factory[/b][/url], where a peaceful tune will play when saving the game.

You can change the songs volume, as well as which category the sound plays from, in the configuration menu.
You can follow the author guide below and figure out how to replace the song yourself


[center][youtube]k3DB7x971I8[/youtube][/center]
[center][i][size=2]I can't believe I forgot to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34309]My Own Mod[/url].[/size][/i][/center]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
[b][size=4]AUTHOR GUIDE[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
You can replace the sound cue (DylanJames.SaveJingle) with Content Patcher.
Here is an example. There is also a funny example mod in the Miscellaneous section.

[code]{
  "Format": "2.9.0",
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "EditData",
      "Target": "Data/AudioChanges",
      "Priority": "Late",
      "Fields": {
        "DylanJames.SaveJingle": {
          "FilePaths": [
            "{{AbsoluteFilePath: assets/LessFittingJingle.ogg}}"
          ]
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}[/code]
[url=https://codeberg.org/dylanjames-xyz/SaveJingle/][b]Source Code[/b][/url]. Also see 'Mirrors'.
